decision_rationale: This is a web-based curated platform/resource for TCM data and analysis, not a primary model paper. It includes bilingual terminology and an LLM-assisted normalization pipeline, but no foundation-model development is described.

Unify is presented as a transfer-learning framework for cross-species single-cell embeddings. The abstract explicitly combines scRNA-seq with protein language model and general-purpose language model embeddings.
evidence_snippet: "combining RNA expression with embeddings from protein language models and general-purpose language models"

decision_rationale: This is a review that proposes a conceptual framework rather than reporting a new model. The abstract explicitly describes GenAI-powered agents with a large language model as the computational backbone.
evidence_snippet: "This review aimed to"; "propose a conceptual framework"; "large language model as the computational backbone"

decision_rationale: The abstract describes an integrated multi-omics analysis framework augmented by generative AI and LLM-guided augmentation, but not a concrete generative architecture. That reads as a wrapper-style application rather than a foundational model paper.
evidence_snippet: "integrated multi-omics framework combining transcriptomics, microbiome analysis, and generative AI"; "LLM-guided augmentation improved model stability"

decision_rationale: This is explicitly a narrative review of AI applications in obstetrics, not a primary model paper. It mentions NLP among reviewed application areas, but not a single substantive text-bio model.
evidence_snippet: "We conducted a narrative (non-systematic) review"; "natural language processing (NLP)"

decision_rationale: AsymST is a primary predictive model for histology-to-spatial-transcriptomics mapping. The abstract describes image and gene-expression modeling, with no text component or text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: "predicting spatially resolved gene expression directly from the haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) slides"
